cards.en:
Pseudocode expresses an algorithm in a structured, human-readable way, but it is not a language that computers can understand. To make a computer run an algorithm we must write it in a programming language, e.g. Python or C++.

Like natural languages, programming languages each have their own unique features and syntax. The same algorithm (e.g. finding the area of a square) can be written in pseudocode, Python and C++:
  • Pseudocode: Input length, area ← length * length, Output area.
  • Python: no variable declaration, input() then float() conversion, print() for output.
  • C++: needs #include <iostream>, a main() function, variables declared with a data type first (float area, length;), cin >> for input, cout << for output, and ; at the end of each statement.
Key point: the algorithm (logic) is the same; only the syntax differs. Python is shorter and easier to read, which is why it is used for beginners.
cards.zh:
伪代码 (pseudocode) 用结构化、人看得懂的方式描述算法，但电脑不能直接理解伪代码。要让电脑执行，必须用编程语言 (programming language) 写出来，例如 Python、C++。

各种编程语言像自然语言一样，有各自的特点和语法 (syntax)。书中用"求正方形面积"做对比：
  • 伪代码：Input length、area ← length * length、Output area。
  • Python：不用先宣告变量；input() 读入后用 float() 转型；print() 输出。
  • C++：要 #include <iostream>、main()，变量要先宣告数据类型（float area, length;），用 cin >> 输入、cout << 输出，每句以 ; 结尾。
重点：算法逻辑相同，只是语法不同。Python 简洁易读，适合初学。

ex.q:
Convert the pseudocode 
Output "Please enter a side length for a square:"
Input length
area ← length * length
Output area
into Python.
ex.a:
length = input("Please enter a side length for a square: ")
length = float(length)
area = length * length
print(area)
Step 1: input() shows the prompt and reads a string. Step 2: float() converts it to a number. Step 3: assignment uses = instead of ←. Step 4: Output becomes print().
ex.az: ← 变成 =；Input 变成 input()，但要记得用 float() 转成数字；Output 变成 print()。

cards.en:
The book introduces several languages and their typical uses:
  • Python: an interpreted scripting language known for simplicity and ease of use; used in almost every field (AI, data science, web, e.g. Instagram uses the Django framework, Spotify uses Python for data analysis/recommendations). Created by Guido van Rossum in the late 1980s, designed to be concise and readable.
  • C++: one of the most common languages, less abstract; used in embedded systems for highly efficient hardware control.
  • Rust: general-purpose, similar to C++ but newer.
  • VBA: owned by Microsoft; macros/automated scripts in the Office suite.
  • Fortran: scientific computing (weather prediction, chemical simulation); once coded on punch cards.
  • JavaScript: web development, e.g. client-side scripting for data validation.
  • Java: "write once, run everywhere"; Android apps.
  • Assembly: high performance, simple for the computer, but hard for humans to read/write.
  • R: statistics and data analysis.
  • Swift: by Apple, for iPhone/iPad apps.
cards.zh:
课本介绍的语言及用途：
  • Python：解释型脚本语言 (interpreted scripting language)，简单易用，几乎各领域都用（AI、数据分析、网站；Instagram 用 Django、Spotify 用来推荐歌曲、Netflix CDN）。由荷兰程序员 Guido van Rossum 于 1980 年代后期创造，设计重点是简洁易读，函数库丰富。
  • C++：最常用之一，较不抽象，常用于嵌入式系统，追求硬件效率。
  • Rust：类似 C++，较新。VBA：微软，用于 Office 宏 (macro)。Fortran：科学计算，例如天气预测，早期用打孔卡。
  • JavaScript：网页，例如客户端数据验证 (client-side data validation)。Java：write once, run everywhere，Android 应用。
  • Assembly：效能高，但人难读难写。R：统计。Swift：Apple 开发 iOS 应用。

ex.q: A developer wants to (i) validate a web form in the browser and (ii) build an iPad app. Suggest a language for each.
ex.a: (i) JavaScript, used for client-side scripting such as data validation. (ii) Swift, Apple's language for iPhone/iPad apps.
ex.az: (i) JavaScript；(ii) Swift。

cards.tz: 集成开发环境 IDE 与 Thonny
cards.en:
An Integrated Development Environment (IDE) is an application that usually has a code editor with numerous programming-related functions (e.g. running, debugging, showing variables, syntax colouring).

The book uses Thonny, an IDE designed for Python beginners (V3.3.10 or later recommended). In Thonny:
  • File → Save as to save a .py program.
  • Click the Run button or press F5 to run; output appears in the Shell (互動環境).
  • Thonny shows keywords in purple, comments in light grey, and highlights syntax errors.
  • Tab / Shift+Tab add/remove indentation.
Online Python development platforms also exist, letting you write and run Python in a browser: Replit, GDB (online compiler), Google Colab and Jupyter Notebook.
cards.zh:
集成开发环境 (Integrated Development Environment, IDE)：一种通常包含代码编辑器及许多编程相关功能的应用程序（执行、除错、显示变量、语法上色等）。

课本用 Thonny（建议 V3.3.10 或以上），专为 Python 初学者设计：
  • File → Save as 储存 .py 档。
  • 按 Run 或 F5 执行，结果在 Shell（互動環境）显示。
  • 关键字显示紫色，注释显示浅灰色，语法错误会被标示。
  • Tab/Shift+Tab 增减缩排。
网上 Python 开发平台：Replit、GDB、Colab、Jupyter Notebook，在浏览器就能写和执行程序。

ex.q: State two functions an IDE provides besides a text editor.
ex.a: Any two: running the program and showing output in a shell; debugging/showing error messages; syntax highlighting (e.g. keywords in colour); showing variable values; indentation tools.
ex.az: 例如：执行程序并显示输出、显示错误信息、语法上色、查看变量值。

cards.en:
"Hello World" is the simplest and most basic program; its only purpose is to print the text "Hello World!". It lets beginners get familiar with a new language.
print("Hello World!")
print("Python is fun")
Output:
Hello World!
Python is fun
print() literally means "output": it displays the content inside the brackets in the Shell. Each print() starts on a new line by default. You can change the string inside the quotation marks to anything you like.
cards.zh:
"Hello World" 是最简单最基本的程序，唯一目的就是印出 "Hello World!"，让初学者熟悉新语言。
print() 在 Python 中的意思就是"输出 (output)"：把括号内的内容显示在 Shell。每个 print() 默认另起一行，所以两句 print 会印出两行。引号内的字符串可以随意更改。

ex.q: Write a program that prints Hello World! on one line and Python is fun on the next.
ex.a:
print("Hello World!")
print("Python is fun")
Each print() ends with a line break, so the two strings appear on separate lines.
ex.az: 两句 print，各自一行。

cards.tz: 语法错误：Hello World 除错
cards.en:
Pseudocode is for humans, so its syntax is loose (e.g. "output" vs "print", "/" vs "÷"). But in a programming language we must follow the strict syntax, otherwise the program cannot run: changing * to x or " to curly quotes “ ” makes the code un-understandable to the computer.
Common errors from Activity 4.1 (read the error message in the Shell):
CodeError / cause
Print("Hello Warld!")NameError: name 'Print' is not defined. Python is case-sensitive; must be lowercase print. (The typo "Warld" inside a string is NOT an error.)
print"Hello World!"SyntaxError: missing brackets ( ).
print(Hello World!)SyntaxError: missing quotation marks around the string.
print("Hello World!"SyntaxError: unexpected EOF while parsing: missing closing bracket.
cards.zh:
伪代码给人看，语法宽松；但编程语言必须遵守严格语法，否则程序无法执行（例如把 * 写成 x，或用中文弯引号 “ ”）。
Activity 4.1 常见错误（要看 Shell 的错误信息）：
  • Print(...)：NameError，Python 区分大小写 (case-sensitive)，要写小写 print。字符串里拼错 Warld 不算错误。
  • print"..."：缺括号 → SyntaxError。
  • print(Hello World!)：缺引号 → SyntaxError。
  • print("Hello World!"：缺右括号 → unexpected EOF while parsing。

ex.q:
State the cause of error: 
Print("Hi")
ex.a: NameError: name 'Print' is not defined. Python is case-sensitive; the built-in function is print in lowercase.
ex.az: Python 区分大小写，Print 不是 print。

cards.en:
Most programming languages require us to declare the name and data type of any variable we are going to use. Variables follow naming rules (see Core D 2.1) and cannot be named arbitrarily.
In Python, we cannot use keywords as variable names. Keywords are reserved by the language and have predetermined meanings, e.g. for, and, or, while, if (the book also lists print; strictly print is a built-in function name, and using it as a variable breaks later print() calls). Thonny shows keywords in purple.
After declaring, the name becomes the identifier (識別符) of the variable.
Python does not require declaration: it tags the data type to the value during assignment. = is the assignment operator; the type is set automatically from the data. type() returns the data type, e.g. length = 12 → <class 'int'>; length = 12.0 → <class 'float'>.
Python also lets a variable switch data types in the same program. (C++ must declare first, e.g. float area, length;, and does not allow a variable to change type.)
cards.zh:
多数语言要先宣告 (declare) 变量的名称和数据类型；命名要符合规则（Core D 2.1）。
Python 中不能用关键字 (keyword) 当变量名：关键字被语言保留并有预设意义，例如 for, and, or, while, if（课本也列了 print）。Thonny 以紫色显示关键字。
宣告后，名称就是变量的识别符 (identifier)。
Python 不需宣告，而是在赋值时为数值"标签"数据类型：= 是赋值运算符 (assignment operator)。type() 传回类型：length = 12 → int；12.0 → float；"The length is twelve" → str。同一变量可在程序中转换成不同类型。C++ 则必须先宣告且不可改变类型。

ex.q:
What is printed? 
length = 12
print(type(length))
length = "twelve"
print(type(length))
ex.a:
<class 'int'>
<class 'str'>
Python tags the type from the value at each assignment, so the same variable becomes a str.
ex.az: 同一变量先是 int，再被赋值成 str。

cards.t: Data types: int, float, bool, str
cards.en:
Data types define the types to which values stored in variables belong. The computer assigns suitable memory space based on the data type, and the type determines which arithmetical, relational or logical operations can be performed without errors.
TypeDataExamples
Integer (int)whole numbers, positive and negative288, -101
Float (float)integers and decimals56.5, -30.0, -0.382
Boolean (bool)either True or False1 (True), 0 (False)
String (str)a series of characters: letters, numbers, special symbols"abc", "P$ssword123", "1", "k"
Note: a string is formed by characters and is really a data structure, but is used directly as a data type. Python treats a character as a string of length 1. "1" is a string, not an integer; -30.0 is a float even though it is a whole number.
cards.zh:
数据类型 (data type) 决定变量值属于哪一类。电脑会按类型分配合适的内存空间，类型也决定可做哪些算术、关系或逻辑运算而不出错。
  • int 整数：288、-101
  • float 浮点数：整数和小数，56.5、-30.0
  • bool 布尔：只有 True / False（1 / 0）
  • str 字符串：一串字符，可含字母、数字、符号，如 "P$ssword123"、"1"
字符串由字符组成，本质是数据结构；Python 把单个字符当作长度 1 的字符串。注意 "1" 是 str，-30.0 是 float。

ex.q: State the data type of each: (a) -0.5 (b) "404" (c) False (d) 7
ex.a: (a) float (b) str, because it is in quotation marks (c) bool (d) int
ex.az: 引号内一律是字符串。

cards.en:
Type casting uses built-in functions to change the data type of a value:
  • int(): convert to integer. If the parameter is a float, it is rounded down (truncated toward zero) e.g. int(12.1) → 12. int("12") → 12.
  • float(): convert to float, e.g. float("12") → 12.0, float(12) → 12.0.
  • str(): convert to string, e.g. str(12) → "12", str(12.1) → "12.1".
Note printing a string "12" and int 12 looks the same; use type() to tell them apart.
Errors (Activity 4.2): int("12.1") → ValueError: invalid literal for int() with base 10: '12.1' (a string containing a decimal cannot go straight to int; use int(float("12.1"))). int("ten") → ValueError, since "ten" is not digits.
cards.zh:
转换数据类型 (type casting)：
  • int()：转成整数；若参数是浮点数，会向下舍去小数，int(12.1) → 12。
  • float()：float("12") → 12.0。
  • str()：str(12.1) → "12.1"。
印出来 "12" 和 12 看起来一样，要用 type() 分辨。
常见错误：int("12.1") → ValueError（含小数点的字符串不能直接转 int，可用 int(float("12.1"))）；int("ten") 也是 ValueError。

ex.q:
Give the output: 
x = "7.9"
y = float(x)
z = int(y)
print(y, z, type(z))
ex.a:
7.9 7 <class 'int'>
float("7.9") gives 7.9; int(7.9) drops the decimal part giving 7.
ex.az: int() 舍去小数，不是四舍五入。

cards.en:
Some values are fixed, e.g. π = 3.14159. Variables with fixed data are called constants (常數).
Python regards constants as variables and allows changing their values at any time. So by convention Python constants are named in all capital letters, e.g. PI = 3.14159, to remind programmers not to amend the value.
In C++, constants are declared with const, e.g. const float PI = 3.14159; and C++ does not allow changing the value of a constant.
Using constants (e.g. TEST1_WEIGHT = 0.2) makes programs easier to read and to update, since the value is changed in one place only.
cards.zh:
有些值固定不变，例如 π，这类数据称为常数 (constant)。
Python 把常数当作普通变量，随时可以修改，所以惯例上用全大写命名，例如 PI = 3.14159，提醒程序员不要改。
C++ 用 const float PI = 3.14159; 宣告，且不允许修改。
用常数（如 TEST1_WEIGHT = 0.2）令程序易读，要改数值时只改一处。

ex.q: Why is the weight of the exam written as EXAM_WEIGHT = 0.5 rather than typing 0.5 inside the formula?
ex.a: It is a constant: the capital-letter name shows it should not be changed, it makes the formula self-explanatory, and if the weighting changes only one line needs editing.
ex.az: 全大写=常数惯例；易读、易修改。

cards.en:
An assignment statement stores the result of an expression: pseudocode variable ← expression, Python variable = expression. The new value on the right replaces the original value of the variable.
Arithmetic expressions are formed by data (numbers, variables, constants) and arithmetic operators, e.g. 2 * PI * radius.
OperationPseudocodePythonExample
Addition++1+2 → 3
Subtraction−-1-2 → -1
Multiplication* or ×*2*3 → 6
Division/ or ÷/10/3 → 3.333…, 6/2 → 3.0 (always float)
Integer divisionDIV//10//3 → 3, 4//1.5 → 2.0 (quotient)
ModulusMOD%10%3 → 1, 7%4 → 3, 3.5%3 → 0.5 (remainder)
Exponent^**2**3 → 8, 3**2 → 9
Division with / always gives a float, whether or not there is a remainder. // and % give a float if any operand is a float.
cards.zh:
赋值语句：伪代码 variable ← expression，Python variable = expression，右边新值取代变量原有值。
算术表达式由数据和算术运算符 (arithmetic operator) 组成：
  • + − *（伪代码可写 ×）
  • / 除法：结果一定是 float，6/2 → 3.0
  • // 整数除法 (DIV)：商，10//3 → 3；4//1.5 → 2.0
  • % 模数 (MOD)：余数，10%3 → 1；3.5%3 → 0.5
  • ** 指数（伪代码 ^）：2**3 → 8
有浮点数参与时 // 和 % 结果也是 float。

ex.q: Find the value of y: (a) y = 17 // 5 (b) y = 17 % 5 (c) y = 9 / 3 (d) y = 2 ** 4
ex.a: (a) 3 (quotient) (b) 2 (remainder) (c) 3.0 (division always float) (d) 16

cards.en:
= is not the only assignment operator. Compound assignment operators combine an arithmetic operator with assignment; they are short forms:
OperatorAbbreviatedEqual to
+=y += 2y = y + 2
-=y -= 3y = y - 3
*=y *= 4y = y * 4
/=y /= 5y = y / 5
%=y %= 6y = y % 6
Careful: y = y * (y + 2) can only be rewritten as y *= (y + 2), because the whole right side is evaluated first and then multiplied. They are very common as counters (count += 1) and accumulators (total += x).
cards.zh:
复合赋值运算符 (compound assignment operator) 是算术运算符与赋值的简写：y += 2 即 y = y + 2；还有 -= *= /= %=。
注意 y = y * (y + 2) 只能写成 y *= (y + 2)（右边整体先计算）。常用于计数器 count += 1 和累加 total += x。

ex.q: y = 5. After y *= y - 3, what is y?
ex.a: Right side first: y - 3 = 2, then y = 5 * 2 = 10.

cards.en:
Typical errors with variables:
  • "code" = 404: a string literal cannot be a variable name (left side of = must be a variable). Also print("code") prints the word code, not the value.
  • SUBJECT = "ICT" then print(subject): NameError; Python is case-sensitive, SUBJECT ≠ subject.
  • B = A + 1 when A has never been assigned: NameError, a variable must be given a value before it is used.
  • import = "5**": import is a keyword, cannot be a variable name (SyntaxError).
  • nickname = fullname - "Chan": TypeError, the - operator is not defined for strings (data type decides allowed operations).
Misconception: if the content in print() has quotation marks, it is a string and printed as-is; without quotes, it is treated as a variable and its value is printed: code = 404; print("code") → code; print(code) → 404.
cards.zh:
变量常见错误：
  • "code" = 404：字符串不能做变量名。
  • 大小写不同（SUBJECT/subject）→ NameError。
  • 变量未赋值就使用 → NameError。
  • import 是关键字，不能当变量名。
  • 字符串不能做减法 → TypeError。
误解 (misconception)：print() 括号内有引号 = 字符串，原样印出；没引号 = 变量，印出它的值。print("code") 印 code，print(code) 印 404。

ex.q:
State the cause: 
score = 80
print(Score)
ex.a: NameError: name 'Score' is not defined. Python is case-sensitive; the variable is score (lowercase).
ex.az: 大小写不同的变量名是不同变量。

cards.en:
Comments (註解) explain parts of the code in simple words. Programming is often a long-term project with many people, so commenting is a good and necessary habit.
  • Comments do not affect program operation: they are ignored by the compiler/interpreter.
  • Purpose: make the program more readable so you and others can understand it quickly later.
  • Because Python does not declare data types and a variable can change type at any time, clear comments help avoid design errors (e.g. noting "the data type of area is float").
  • In Python, all text after # in a line is a comment. Thonny shows comments in light grey.
# This program is to calculate the area of a square
length = float(length)   # Change the data type of length to float
cards.zh:
注释 (comment)：用简单文字解释部分代码。编程常是多人长期合作，写注释是良好且必要的习惯。
  • 注释不影响程序运行，会被编译器忽略。
  • 目的：令程序更易读。
  • Python 不宣告类型、变量可随时改类型，清楚注释可减少设计错误。
  • Python 中一行里 # 之后的文字都是注释，Thonny 显示为浅灰色。

ex.q:
What is the output? 
x = 3  # x = 10
# x = x + 1
print(x)
ex.a: 3. Everything after # is ignored, so only x = 3 and print(x) run.
ex.az: # 后面都不执行。

cards.t: Converting pseudocode to Python and dry run (Activity 4.4)
cards.tz: 伪代码转 Python 与手动追踪
cards.en:
When converting: ← becomes =, × becomes *, "cube of B" becomes B ** 3, "remainder of (A ÷ B)" becomes A % B, "integral part of (A ÷ B)" becomes A // B, Output becomes print().
A dry run means tracing the code by hand, recording the value of each variable after each line. Example from Activity 4.4: 
a = 12
b = a + 10    # 22
c = b % 10    # 2
a = a**c      # 144
print(a//b)   # 144//22 = 6
print(type(a//b))  # <class 'int'>
cards.zh:
转换规则：← → =；× → *；"cube of B" → B ** 3；"remainder of (A÷B)" → A % B；"integral part" → A // B；Output → print()。
手动追踪 (dry run)：逐行记录每个变量的值。上例 a=12，b=22，c=2，a=144，144//22=6，类型 int。

ex.q:
Convert and give output: 
A ← 3
B ← 2
B ← 2 * (A + B)
C ← cube of B
Output C - B
Pseudocode: A ← 9, B ← A × 5, Output remainder of (A ÷ B), Output integral part of (A ÷ B). Give Python and output.
ex.az: 9 除以 45 商 0 余 9。

cards.t: Output statements: print() with strings, variables, expressions
cards.en:
print() prints the content within the brackets. The content can be:
  • String: displays all characters within the quotation marks. print("Text") → Text
  • Variable: prints the value. length = 10; print(length) → 10
  • Expression / several items: prints the parameters sequentially; items of different data types are separated by ",", and a whitespace is added automatically between them: name = "Tom"; print("Hi", name) → Hi Tom
Examples (Lab 4.2): print("Hi", name, "your mark is", mark) with name "David", mark 89 → Hi David your mark is 89.
cards.zh:
print() 印出括号内容，可以是：
  • 字符串：引号内所有字符原样显示。
  • 变量：印出其值。
  • 多个参数/表达式：按次序印出，用逗号 , 分隔，自动在之间加一个空格。print("Hi", name) → Hi Tom。
用逗号可以混合不同类型（str 与 int），不用转型。

ex.q: name = "David", mark = 89. Output of print("Hi", name, "your mark is", mark)?
ex.a: Hi David your mark is 89: four items printed in order with one space between each.
ex.az: 逗号之间自动加空格。

cards.en:
Escape character: to put a quotation mark inside a string, add a backslash (\) before it. The backslash "escapes from" (cancels) its original syntactic function.
print("print something \"special\"") → print something "special"

end parameter: print() by default adds a line break after printing, so the next content starts on a new line. Adding end = "" changes the last string output, so the next printed content stays on the same line. 
name = "Tom"
print("Hi", end="")
print(name, end="")
print("Bye")
Output: HiTomBye (no spaces, since end="" adds nothing). Without end="", output would be three lines Hi / Tom / Bye.
cards.zh:
转义字符 (escape character)：字符串内要放引号，就在前面加反斜线 \，取消它原本的语法作用：print("say \"hi\"") → say "hi"。
end 参数：print() 默认在最后加换行；加 end="" 后，下一次输出会留在同一行。上例输出 HiTomBye（没有空格）。也可用 end=" " 加空格。

ex.q:
Output? 
for i in range(3):
    print(i, end=",")
print("end")
ex.a: 0,1,2,end: each print ends with "," instead of a new line.
ex.az: end 改成逗号，所以都在同一行。

cards.en:
Programs often need users to input values. Pseudocode Input length → Python length = input().
The input obtained by input() is stored as a string. To do arithmetic, change its type with int() or float(): length = float(input()).
Prompt: putting a string inside input() prints a message before the cursor on the same line: name = input("Please input your name: ").
Lab 4.3 results:
  • length = input() → type str
  • int(input()) → int; float(input()) → float
  • int × float → float (20 × 15.0 = 300.0)
  • A = input(); B = input(); sum = A + B with inputs 1 and 1 → "11" (string concatenation), type str.
Debug (Activity 4.5): mark = int(input() missing closing bracket → SyntaxError; (mark1 + mark2) / 2 with string inputs → TypeError (str / int) because input() was not converted.
cards.zh:
伪代码 Input length → Python length = input()。
input() 取得的输入一律以字符串 (string) 储存，要计算须用 int() 或 float() 转型。
提示字符串：input("Please input your name: ") 会先印出提示，光标停在同一行。
重点：两个 input() 相加 "1"+"1" 得 "11"（字符串连接）；int×float 得 float。忘记转型再做除法 → TypeError；括号不完整 → SyntaxError。

ex.q:
User enters 4 then 6. Output? 
a = input()
b = input()
print(a + b)
print(int(a) + int(b))
ex.a:
46
10
input() gives strings, so a + b joins them; after int() conversion they are added.
ex.az: 字符串相加是连接，转 int 后才是加法。

cards.tz: 例 4.1：货币兑换（输入-处理-输出）
cards.en:
Steps to analyse a problem:
  1. Define variables (name, data type, use): JPY_rate float stores exchange rate; JPYDollar float amount in JPY; HKDollar float amount to pay.
  2. Output needed information (rate, instructions).
  3. Input the amount and store it.
  4. Process: HKDollar = JPYDollar * JPY_rate.
  5. Output the result.
JPY_rate = 0.071
print("Today's exchange rate is 1 JPY =", JPY_rate, "HKD")
JPYDollar = float(input("Please enter the amount to be exchanged (in JPY): "))
HKDollar = JPYDollar * JPY_rate
print("You need to pay", HKDollar, "HKD. Thank you.")
Input 1000000 → You need to pay 71000.0 HKD. Thank you. This Input → Process → Output structure is the pattern for all 4.2 checkpoint programs.
cards.zh:
分析步骤：① 定义变量（名称、类型、用途）② 输出所需信息 ③ 输入金额 ④ 处理：HKDollar = JPYDollar * JPY_rate ⑤ 输出结果。
输入 1000000 日元，输出 71000.0 HKD。所有 4.2 的练习都是这个"输入→处理→输出"模式。

ex.q: Modify Example 4.1 to convert HKD to JPY instead (1 JPY = 0.071 HKD).
ex.a:
JPY_rate = 0.071
HKDollar = float(input("Amount in HKD: "))
JPYDollar = HKDollar / JPY_rate
print("You will get", JPYDollar, "JPY")
Process step changes to division by the rate.
ex.az: 换方向就把乘改成除。

cards.t: Checkpoint programs: area, perimeter, cylinder, BMI, time
cards.tz: 练习程序：面积、周长、圆柱、BMI、时间
cards.en:
Typical formula programs in 4.2:
  • Rectangle area: area = length * width; perimeter: perimeter = 2 * (length + width) (35, 10 → 90).
  • Circle: area = PI * r ** 2 (r = 5, PI = 3.14 → 78.5). Trapezium: (a + b) * h / 2 ((13+26)×5/2 = 97.5).
  • Cylinder (diameter input): r = d / 2, vol = PI * r**2 * h, area = 2*PI*r*h + 2*PI*r**2. d = 5.5, h = 10 → 237.4625 and 220.1925.
  • Weighted result: overall = test1*0.2 + test2*0.3 + exam*0.5 (60, 70, 85 → 75.5).
  • BMI: weight / height ** 2.
  • Seconds → minutes and seconds: minutes = time // 60, seconds = time % 60 (125 → 2 minute(s) and 5 second(s)).
cards.zh: 4.2 常见公式程序：长方形面积/周长、圆面积 PI * r ** 2、梯形 (a+b)*h/2、圆柱（输入直径要先 r = d/2）、加权成绩、BMI weight / height ** 2、秒转分秒用 // 和 %。

ex.q: Write a program: input seconds (integer), output e.g. Your record is 2 minute(s) and 5 second(s).
ex.a:
time = int(input("Input the number of seconds: "))
minutes = time // 60
seconds = time % 60
print("Your record is", minutes, "minute(s) and", seconds, "second(s).")
125 // 60 = 2, 125 % 60 = 5.
ex.az: // 取分钟，% 取余下秒数。

cards.en:
A function takes parameter(s) (input), does a process, and gives a return value (output).
Python has many built-in functions (內置函數): print(), input(), type(), int(), float(), str() and more:
FunctionDescriptionExample
abs(x)absolute value of xabs(-10) → 10; abs(20) → 20
round(x, y)round x to y decimal placesround(10/3, 2) → 3.33; round(10/3, 5) → 3.33333
Note round(x) with no second argument returns an int. (Python rounds exact halves to the even number, e.g. round(2.5) → 2; DSE questions rarely test this.)
cards.zh:
函数 (function)：接收参数 (parameter, 输入)、进行处理、传回值 (return value, 输出)。
内置函数 (built-in function) 包括 print、input、type、int、float、str，另有：
  • abs(x)：绝对值，abs(-10) → 10
  • round(x, y)：x 四舍五入到 y 位小数，round(10/3, 2) → 3.33

ex.q: Output of print(abs(3 - 8), round(7/4, 1))?
ex.a: abs(-5) = 5; 7/4 = 1.75 → round to 1 d.p. = 1.8. Output: 5 1.8

cards.en:
To use functions other than built-in ones we need to import a library (函數庫). A library is formed by many functions with related uses; they can be used after the library is imported. Analogy: a library is like a toolbox.
A library only needs to be imported once in each program, before its functions are used.
FunctionDescriptionExample
math.sqrt(x)square rootmath.sqrt(16) → 4.0
math.sin(x)sine of x radian
math.cos(x)cosine of x radian
math.exp(x)exmath.exp(10) → 22026.4657…
The library also provides constants such as math.pi. Example (Checkpoint 4.3, Pythagoras): 
import math
a = float(input("One side of right triangle: "))
b = float(input("Another side of right triangle: "))
c = math.sqrt(a**2 + b**2)
print("The length of hypotenuse side is", c)
4, 3 → 5.0
cards.zh:
要用内置以外的函数，须导入函数库 (import library)；库像工具箱，由多个相关函数组成。每个程序只需在使用前导入一次。
math 库：math.sqrt(16) → 4.0（结果是 float）；sin/cos 参数用弧度 (radian)；exp(x) = ex；常数 math.pi。
例：勾股定理 c = math.sqrt(a**2 + b**2)，输入 4、3 得 5.0。

ex.q: Write a line computing the area of a circle of radius r using the math library's π, rounded to 2 d.p.
ex.a:
import math
area = round(math.pi * r ** 2, 2)
For r = 5 this gives 78.54.
ex.az: 用 math.pi，再 round 到两位。

cards.en:
Randomness is used in lucky draws and games. After import random:
FunctionDescriptionRange of y
random.random()random float from 0 to 1 (excluding 1)0 ≤ y < 1
random.uniform(a, b)random float from a to b (book: excluding b)1 ≤ y < 10 for (1, 10)
random.randint(a, b)random integer from a to b, both inclusive1 ≤ y ≤ 10 for (1, 10)
Checkpoint 4.4 (lottery machine): 
import random
DrawNumber = random.randint(1, 100)
print(DrawNumber)
Note: randint includes the upper bound, unlike range().
cards.zh:
import random 后：
  • random.random()：0 至 1 的随机浮点数，不包括 1
  • random.uniform(a, b)：a 至 b 的随机浮点数
  • random.randint(a, b)：a 至 b 的随机整数，两端都包括
抽奖机：DrawNumber = random.randint(1, 100)。注意 randint 包括上限，range() 不包括。

ex.q: Write an expression that simulates rolling a six-sided die.
ex.a: random.randint(1, 6) (after import random), giving an integer 1 to 6 inclusive.
ex.az: randint(1, 6)。

cards.en:
Python evaluates arithmetic in the usual mathematical order:
  1. Brackets ( )
  2. Exponent ** (right to left: 2**3**2 = 2**9 = 512)
  3. Unary minus (-2**2 = -4)
  4. * / // % left to right
  5. + - left to right
Then relational operators (== != < > <= >=), then not, and, or.
So 2 * PI * radius multiplies left to right; (a + b) * h / 2 needs brackets, while a + b * h / 2 would be wrong. When unsure, add brackets: it makes code clearer and avoids logic errors.
cards.zh:
运算次序：括号 → **（由右至左）→ 负号 → * / // %（左至右）→ + -；然后关系运算符，再 not、and、or。
例如 -2**2 = -4；梯形面积必须写 (a + b) * h / 2。不确定就加括号。

ex.q: Evaluate 7 + 8 % 3 * 2 ** 2.
ex.az: 先指数，再 % 和 * 由左至右，最后加。

cards.en:
The selection control structure (選擇控制結構) allows the program to make decisions in the form of binary-way (對分) or multi-way (多向) selection based on specified conditions.
  • Binary-way: two possible paths (if…then, if…then…else).
  • Multi-way: more than two options, built by adding branches (nested conditions, if…elif…else).
Together with sequence and iteration, selection is one of the three basic control structures used to write any program. A selection is driven by a condition, which is a Boolean expression evaluated to True or False.
cards.zh:
选择控制结构 (selection control structure) 让程序根据指定条件作出决定，形式有对分 (binary-way) 和多向 (multi-way)。
对分：两条路径（if…then、if…then…else）；多向：超过两个选项（嵌套条件、if…elif…else）。
选择与顺序 (sequence)、迭代 (iteration) 是三种基本控制结构。选择由条件 (condition) 决定，条件是一个布尔表达式。

ex.q: Classify: (a) print Pass/Fail by mark; (b) print grade A/B/C/D/F by mark.
ex.a: (a) binary-way selection (two outcomes); (b) multi-way selection (more than two outcomes, e.g. if…elif…else).
ex.az: (a) 对分 (b) 多向。

cards.tz: 布尔表达式与关系运算符
cards.en:
A Boolean expression (布爾算式) gives only two possible results: True or False, so the result belongs to the Boolean (bool) data type. Relational operators (關係運算符) are used in Boolean expressions, e.g. mark >= 50.
PseudocodePythonMeaningmark = 50
===equal toTrue
<<less thanFalse
≤ or <=<=less than or equal toTrue
>>greater thanFalse
≥ or >=>=greater than or equal toTrue
≠, != or <>!=not equal toFalse
Note Python uses == (two equal signs) for "equal to" and != for "not equal to"; <> is not valid in Python 3.
cards.zh:
布尔表达式 (Boolean expression) 只有 True/False 两个结果，属 bool 类型。关系运算符 (relational operator)：== < <= > >= !=。
伪代码的 = 在 Python 写 ==；≠ 写 !=（Python 3 不接受 <>）。mark = 50 时：==50 True，<50 False，<=50 True，>=50 True，!=50 False。

ex.q: x = 7. Evaluate: (a) x % 2 == 1 (b) x != 7 (c) x * 2 >= 14
ex.a: (a) 7 % 2 = 1 → True (b) False (c) 14 >= 14 → True
ex.az: % 2 == 1 是判断奇数的常用写法。

cards.tz: 误解：== 与 = 的分别
cards.en:
Relational operator == is used in a Boolean expression, which gives True or False and acts as an evaluation condition.
Assignment operator = is used in an assignment statement, which replaces the original value of the variable on the left with the value on the right.
mark = 70
if mark = 100:        # wrong: SyntaxError
    message = "You got full marks!"

if mark == 100:       # correct
    message = "You got full marks!"
Also: if the condition is False and message is never assigned, a later print(message) causes a NameError (Activity 4.6), so give the variable a value in every branch (use else).
cards.zh:
== 关系运算符：用在布尔表达式，结果 True/False，作为判断条件。
= 赋值运算符：用在赋值语句，把右边的值取代左边变量的原值。
if mark = 100: → SyntaxError，必须写 ==。另外若条件为 False 而变量 message 从未赋值，之后 print(message) 会 NameError，所以每个分支都要给值（用 else）。

ex.q:
Explain why this fails: 
mark = 70
if mark == 100:
    message = "Full marks!"
print(message)
ex.a: The condition is False, so message is never assigned. print(message) then raises NameError: name 'message' is not defined. Fix: add else: message = "..." or assign a default before the if.
ex.az: 条件不成立，变量没有被赋值。

cards.en:
Binary-way selection uses a Boolean expression as the condition (條件). In an if…then statement: when the condition is True, the "then" body is executed; when False, the "then" body is ignored and the conditional statement ends. 
Pseudocode            Python
mark ← 70             mark = 70
if mark >= 50 then    if mark >= 50:
    grade ← "Pass"        grade = "Pass"
Output grade          print(grade)
Python syntax: if + condition + colon :, then the body indented. The "then" body can be a block of statements. Flowchart: a diamond for the condition, True arrow to the body, False arrow bypasses it.
cards.zh:
if…then：条件为 True 执行 "then" 主体；False 则略过，条件语句结束。
Python 语法：if 条件:（必须有冒号），下一行开始的主体要缩排；主体可以是多句（语句块）。流程图：菱形放条件，True 指向主体，False 绕过。

ex.q: Write Python: if temperature is above 30, print "Hot".
ex.a:
if temperature > 30:
    print("Hot")
Colon after the condition; body indented.
ex.az: 记得冒号和缩排。

cards.en:
When the condition is True, the "then" body is executed; when False, the "then" body is ignored but the "else" body is executed before the statement ends. Exactly one of the two bodies always runs. 
mark = 70
if mark >= 50:
    grade = "Pass"
else:
    grade = "Fail"
print(grade)
Syntax: else: also needs a colon, and else must align with its corresponding if. Pseudocode: if {condition} then … else ….
cards.zh:
条件为 True 执行 then 主体；False 则执行 else 主体。两者必定只执行其一。
语法：else: 也要冒号，且 else 必须与对应的 if 对齐。

ex.q:
Output when mark = 45? 
if mark >= 50:
    grade = "Pass"
else:
    grade = "Fail"
print(grade)
ex.a: 45 >= 50 is False, so the else body runs: output Fail.
ex.az: 条件 False → else。

cards.en:
Indentation (縮排) is a very important syntax in Python. It shows the logical structure of the program, indicating which branch the statements belong to. 
if mark >= 50:
    print("Pass")
    print("Promoted")
else:
    print("Fail")
    print("Repeated")
Both indented lines belong to their branch. Errors from Activity 4.6:
  • Missing colon if mark >= 50 → SyntaxError.
  • if mark = 100: → SyntaxError (use ==).
  • Body not indented under if → IndentationError (expected an indented block).
  • print("Fail") written un-indented after else: → IndentationError.
  • A statement un-indented after the else body (e.g. print("Fail") at column 0) is outside the if; it always runs → a logic error (prints Fail even for a pass).
  • Unexpected extra indent → IndentationError.
In Thonny, Tab adds and Shift+Tab removes indentation.
cards.zh:
缩排 (indentation) 是 Python 非常重要的语法，表示程序的逻辑结构，即语句属于哪个分支。
Activity 4.6 错误：漏冒号 → SyntaxError；if 主体没缩排 → IndentationError；else 后的语句没缩排 → IndentationError；else 主体之后不缩排的语句在 if 之外，每次都执行 → 逻辑错误 (logic error)（及格也会印 Fail）；多余缩排 → IndentationError。Thonny：Tab 加缩排、Shift+Tab 减。

ex.q:
mark = 70. Output? 
if mark >= 50:
    print("Pass")
else:
    print("Work hard next time")
print("Fail")
ex.a:
Pass
Fail
print("Fail") is not indented, so it is outside the if…else and always runs: a logic error.
ex.az: 最后一句不属 else，一定会执行。

cards.en:
To find the smallest value among three numbers: assume the first is the lowest, compare it with the second and keep the lower one, then compare that with the third. The value that remains at the end is the lowest. 
a = float(input("Price of shop A: "))
b = float(input("Price of shop B: "))
c = float(input("Price of shop C: "))
if a < b:
    min = a
else:
    min = b
if c < min:
    min = c
print("The lowest price is", min)
10, 8.9, 9.9 → 8.9. This extends to four numbers by adding one more if d < min: min = d. To also show which shop, keep a second variable shop updated in each branch. (Naming a variable min hides the built-in min() function; a name like lowest is better practice.)
cards.zh: 求三个数中最小值：先假设第一个最小，与第二个比较留下较小者，再与第三个比较，最后留下的就是最小。四个数就再加一句 if d < min: min = d。要显示是哪间店，就另设变量 shop 在每个分支更新。（用 min 做变量名会遮蔽内置函数 min()，最好改名 lowest。）

ex.q: Extend to also print the shop with the lowest price.
ex.a:
if a < b:
    lowest = a; shop = "A"
else:
    lowest = b; shop = "B"
if c < lowest:
    lowest = c; shop = "C"
print("The lowest price is", lowest, "at shop", shop)
ex.az: 每次更新最低价时同时更新店名。

cards.en:
To swap the values of X and Y, use a temporary variable: 
temp = X
X = Y
Y = temp
Writing X = Y then Y = X fails, because the original value of X is lost after the first line.
Checkpoint 4.5: 
X = int(input())
Y = int(input())
if Y > X:
    temp = X
    X = Y
    Y = temp
print(X - Y)
After the swap X is the larger value, so the program outputs the (absolute) difference between X and Y: (1, 6) → 5; (9, 2) → 7; (-5, 1) → 6; (-3, -10) → 7; (3, -5) → 8; (-20, -7) → 13. Rewritten without swap: if Y > X: print(Y - X) else: print(X - Y), or simply abs(X - Y).
cards.zh:
用临时变量 temp 交换：temp = X; X = Y; Y = temp。直接 X = Y; Y = X 会令 X 原值遗失。
Checkpoint 4.5 程序在 Y > X 时交换，令 X 为较大者，再输出 X − Y，即两数之差的绝对值。也可写成 if…else 或 abs(X - Y)。

ex.q: Inputs X = -20, Y = -7. Trace the Checkpoint 4.5 program.

cards.zh:
需要在超过两个选项中决定时，可在对分选择中加分支形成多向选择。
把一个结构放进另一个结构内称为嵌套结构 (nested structure)。条件语句可嵌在另一条件的 then 或 else 分支内，只有前一个条件结果符合才会进入。每一层多缩排一级。

ex.a: age >= 18 False → else branch; member True → Junior member.
ex.az: 外层 False，进入内层判断。

cards.zh:
if…elif…else：按次序检查条件，直到第一个为 True，执行该分支后整个语句结束；全部不成立就执行 else。
重点：只会执行一个分支；次序重要（用 >= 时由高至低）；后面的条件只在前面都 False 时才检查，所以只需检查下限。

ex.q:
Why is this wrong? 
if mark >= 50:
    grade = "B"
elif mark >= 85:
    grade = "A"
ex.a: Conditions are checked in order. A mark of 90 already satisfies mark >= 50, so grade becomes B and the elif is never reached; nobody can get A. Put mark >= 85 first.
ex.az: 次序错了，A 永远不会出现。

cards.zh:
分析：找出所有条件及检查次序：≥3.60、≥3.00、≥2.40、≥1.70，否则 Pass。由于后面的条件只在前面不成立时才检查，只需写下限。
也可写成由 ≥1.70 开始一层层的嵌套 if…else，结构相似，但Python 缩排要求严格，深层嵌套较易出错，所以 if…elif 较好。

ex.q: GGPA = 3.00. Which result? Which conditions are evaluated?
ex.a: 3.00 >= 3.60 False; 3.00 >= 3.00 True → Second Class Honours (Division One). Only two conditions are evaluated; the rest are skipped.
ex.az: 只检查了两个条件。

cards.t: Checkpoint 4.6: BMI status and grouping with %
cards.tz: BMI 状况与用 % 分组
cards.en:
BMI status: below 18.5 Underweight; 18.5–22.9 Normal; 23–24.9 Overweight; ≥ 25 Obesity: 
if bmi < 18.5:
    print("Underweight")
elif bmi < 23:
    print("Normal weight")
elif bmi < 25:
    print("Overweight")
else:
    print("Obesity")
Cyclic grouping: class no. 1 → RED, 2 → ORANGE, 3 → GREEN, 4 → BLUE, 5 → RED… Use the remainder: group = num % 4; 1 → RED, 2 → ORANGE, 3 → GREEN, 0 → BLUE. 
num = int(input("Please input your class number: "))
group = num % 4
if group == 1:
    print("You are in group RED")
elif group == 2:
    print("You are in group ORANGE")
elif group == 3:
    print("You are in group GREEN")
else:
    print("You are in group BLUE")
23 % 4 = 3 → GREEN; 6 % 4 = 2 → ORANGE.
cards.zh:
BMI 分类用 if…elif…else，由低到高用 <。
循环分组：用 num % 4；余 1 RED、2 ORANGE、3 GREEN、0 BLUE。23 % 4 = 3 → GREEN；6 % 4 = 2 → ORANGE。% 是处理"周期重复"问题的关键。

ex.q: Which group is class number 16? 17?
ex.az: 余 0 是最后一组。

cards.en:
When there is more than one condition, use Boolean operators (布爾運算符), also called logical operators (邏輯運算符), to combine conditions into compound Boolean expressions. In Python they must be typed in small letters: and, or, not.
XYX and YX or Y
TrueTrueTrueTrue
TrueFalseFalseTrue
FalseTrueFalseTrue
FalseFalseFalseFalse
not X: True → False, False → True.
  • and: True only when both are True (e.g. range check X >= 0 and X <= 100).
  • or: True when at least one is True (e.g. age <= 11 or age >= 65).
  • not: negation.
Precedence: not before and before or; use brackets for clarity.
cards.zh:
条件多于一个时，用布尔运算符 (Boolean operator)，又称逻辑运算符 (logical operator)，组成复合布尔表达式。Python 中必须小写：and、or、not。
and：两者都 True 才 True（例如范围检查 0 ≤ X ≤ 100）；or：至少一个 True 就 True；not：取反。优先次序 not → and → or，最好加括号。

ex.q: A = 1, B = 5. Evaluate (a) (A == 1) and (B > 2) (b) (A == 2) or (B > 9) (c) not (A == 1)
ex.a: (a) True and True → True (b) False or False → False (c) not True → False
ex.az: 按真值表逐个计算。

cards.zh:
票价：小童/长者 100、学生（25 岁或以下且持学生证）150、成人 200。变量 age（整数）、isStudent（布尔）。

cards.en:
The iteration (迭代) control structure is also called the loop (循環) control structure. It means repeatedly executing certain statement(s) until the loop condition is no longer true. The statement(s) to be repeated are called the "loop body" (循環體).
Python provides:
  • for loops: use a loop counter variable; number of repetitions known in advance.
  • while loops: repeat as long as a condition is True; number of repetitions may be unknown (e.g. input validation).
Both are pre-test loops. Python has no post-test loop statement.
cards.zh:
迭代 (iteration) 又称循环 (loop) 控制结构：重复执行某些语句，直至循环条件不再成立。被重复的语句称为循环体 (loop body)。
Python 有 for 循环（用计数器，次数预先知道）和 while 循环（条件成立就重复，次数可能未知，如输入验证）。两者都是前测循环 (pre-test loop)，Python 没有后测循环语句。

ex.q: Which loop fits better: (a) print 1 to 100; (b) keep asking for a password until it is correct?
ex.a: (a) for loop: the number of repetitions (100) is known. (b) while loop: repeat while the input is wrong; the count is unknown.
ex.az: 次数已知用 for，未知用 while。

cards.en:
A for loop uses a variable as a loop counter to specify how many times the loop body is repeated. 
Pseudocode: for i from 1 to 5
                Output 3 * i
Python:     for i in range(1, 5+1):    # = range(1, 6)
                print(3 * i)
Output 3 6 9 12 15 (one per line).
In Python, the loop condition is i < last value + 1: range(1, 6) stops before 6, so i = 1…5. range() returns a series of numbers; its parameters must be integers:
FormMeaningExample
range(end)0 to end, step 1, excluding endrange(4) → 0,1,2,3
range(start, end)start to end, excluding endrange(2, 5) → 2,3,4
range(start, end, increment)step by incrementrange(2, 10, 3) → 2,5,8; range(8, 2, -3) → 8,5
Number of iterations of range(a, b) = b − a. The loop body is indented under for … :.
cards.zh:
for 循环用变量作计数器 (loop counter)，指定循环体重复次数。伪代码 for i from 1 to 5 → Python for i in range(1, 6)。Python 的条件是 i < 最后值 + 1，range 不包括 end。
range(end) 由 0 开始；range(start, end)；range(start, end, increment) 步长可为负数。参数必须是整数。range(a, b) 重复 b − a 次。

ex.q: List the values: (a) range(5) (b) range(3, 6) (c) range(5, 0, -1) (d) range(5, -1, -1)
ex.az: end 永远不包括在内。

cards.tz: 手动追踪 for 循环
cards.en:
Record the output and the number of repetitions of the loop body:
CodeOutputRepetitions
for i in range(1, 4): print(i)1 2 33
for k in range(0, 7): print(k)0 … 67
for i in range(3, 6): print(i)3 4 53
for i in range(5): print(i * 2)0 2 4 6 85
for k in range(5, 0, -1): print(k)5 4 3 2 15
for i in range(5, -1, -1): print(i)5 4 3 2 1 06
Accumulator example:
total = 0
for i in range(0, 6):
    total = total + i * 5
    print(total)
print(total/5)
Output: 0, 5, 15, 30, 50, 75 then 15.0 (loop body runs 6 times; last print is outside the loop).
cards.zh: 追踪时记录输出和循环体重复次数（见表）。累加例子：total 依次为 0、5、15、30、50、75，最后 print(total/5) 在循环外，只执行一次，输出 15.0（除法得 float）。

ex.q:
Output and repetitions:

ex.a: 2, 6, 10. Repetitions: 3.
ex.az: 每次加 4，10 < 11 所以包括 10。

cards.t: Common for-loop patterns: counting, summation, factorial, multiples
cards.tz: 常见 for 循环模式
cards.en:
Print a symbol n times on one line (Checkpoint 4.7 stars, 1 star per $10): 
amount = float(input("Please input an amount: "))
star = int(amount // 10)
for i in range(0, star):
    print("*", end="")
49 → 4 stars; 91.1 → 9 stars.
First X multiples of Y: 
for i in range(1, X + 1):
    print(i * Y, "", end="")
X = 4, Y = 3 → 3 6 9 12.
Summation Σn (1 to k): 
summation = 0
for n in range(1, k + 1):
    summation = summation + n
k = 5 → 15.
Factorial n! (0! = 1): 
factorial = 1
for i in range(1, n + 1):
    factorial = factorial * i
5! = 120. Starting factorial at 1 (not 0) is essential; for n = 0 the loop runs zero times and 1 is printed.
cards.zh:
常见模式：
  • 印 n 个符号：for i in range(0, star): print("*", end="")；star = int(amount // 10)。
  • 首 X 个 Y 的倍数：range(1, X + 1) 印 i * Y。
  • 求和 Σ：sum 初值 0，逐个加。
  • 阶乘：初值必须是 1，逐个乘；0! = 1 时循环不执行，直接输出 1。

ex.q: Write a program: input k, output 1 + 2 + … + k.
ex.a:
k = int(input())
summation = 0
for n in range(1, k + 1):
    summation = summation + n
print(summation)
ex.az: 累加器初值 0，range 要到 k + 1。

cards.en:
In a while loop, the condition is evaluated first. If True, the program runs the loop body and evaluates the condition again. As long as the condition remains True, the loop body is executed continuously. 
num = 17
while num < 100:
    print(num)
    num = num + 17
Output: 17, 34, 51, 68, 85 (102 fails the condition).
Key points: the loop body must change something in the condition (here num), otherwise it becomes an infinite loop. Variables in the condition must be initialised before the loop. Syntax: while condition: with an indented body.
Checkpoint 4.8: multiples of Y within X: 
num = Y
while num <= X:
    print(num)
    num = num + Y
cards.zh:
while 循环：先检查条件，True 就执行循环体再检查；只要条件成立就一直执行。上例输出 17、34、51、68、85。
重点：循环体内要改变条件中的变量，否则变成无限循环 (infinite loop)；条件里的变量要先初始化；语法 while 条件: 加缩排。

ex.q:
Output? 
n = 1
while n < 50:
    n = n * 3
print(n)
ex.a: n: 1 → 3 → 9 → 27 → 81; 81 < 50 is False so the loop stops. Output 81.
ex.az: 条件在每次循环开始时检查。

cards.en:
t = int(input())
d = int(input())
r = t
while r >= d:
    r = r - d
print(r)
The loop keeps subtracting d from r while r ≥ d. The result is the remainder of t ÷ d (same as t % d for positive integers). Principle: division is repeated subtraction.
Tests: (10, 3) → 1; (2, 2) → 0; (13, 5) → 3; (3, 7) → 3 (loop never runs); (20, 10) → 0.
Adding a counter q += 1 inside the loop would give the quotient (t // d).
cards.zh: 循环在 r ≥ d 时不断减 d，最后的 r 就是 t ÷ d 的余数（等同 t % d）。原理：除法就是重复相减。测试：(10,3)→1；(2,2)→0；(13,5)→3；(3,7)→3（循环一次都不执行）；(20,10)→0。若在循环内加计数器就得到商。

ex.q: Trace with t = 17, d = 4.
ex.az: 减了 4 次，余 1。

cards.en:
Both for and while loops evaluate the condition first and execute the body only when it is True; if False at the start, the body is not executed at all. They are pre-test loops: the loop body may not be executed at all.
Post-test loops (e.g. do…while, repeat…until) run the body first and test afterwards, so the body runs at least once.
  • do…while: repeat while the condition is True.
  • repeat…until: repeat until the condition becomes True (stops when True).
There are no statements for post-test loops in Python. We simulate one with a while loop: write the loop body once before the while, then repeat it inside the loop (Fig. 4.3).
cards.zh:
for 和 while 都先检查条件，属前测循环 (pre-test loop)，循环体可能一次都不执行。
后测循环 (post-test loop)，例如 do…while、repeat…until，先执行再检查，循环体至少执行一次。do…while 在条件 True 时继续；repeat…until 直到条件 True 才停。
Python 没有后测循环语句，要用 while 模拟：先在循环前执行一次循环体，再用 while 重复。

ex.q:
Rewrite in Python: 
sum ← 0
i ← 0
do
    sum ← sum + 5
    i ← i + 1
while (i < 5)
Output sum
ex.a:
sum = 0
i = 0
sum = sum + 5
i = i + 1
while i < 5:
    sum = sum + 5
    i = i + 1
print(sum)
Body once before the loop, then while. Output 25.
ex.az: 先执行一次，再用 while 重复。

cards.tz: 例 4.5：用 while 验证输入
cards.en:
Design a program that requires the user to input a positive number; if the input is wrong, ask again until a positive number is input.
As there are no post-test loops in Python, use a pre-test loop: input once first, then loop while the input is invalid. 
Pseudocode:          Python:
Input X              num = float(input())
while X <= 0         while num <= 0:
    Input X              num = float(input())
This validation loop pattern (input → while invalid → input again) is used widely, e.g. Chapter Exercise LQ4(b): validate radius and height with two while loops so an invalid height does not make the user re-enter the radius.
cards.zh:
要求用户输入正数，输入错误就要求重新输入。因 Python 没有后测循环，就先输入一次，再 while num <= 0: 重新输入。
这是常用的输入验证循环：输入 → 不合规就再输入。例如圆柱体积题用两个 while 分别验证半径和高度。

ex.q: Write code that keeps asking for a mark until it is between 0 and 100 inclusive.
ex.a:
mark = int(input("Mark: "))
while mark < 0 or mark > 100:
    mark = int(input("Invalid. Mark: "))
The loop condition is the invalid case, joined with or.
ex.az: while 条件写"不合规"的情况。

cards.en:
• Off-by-one: range(1, n) stops at n−1; to include n use range(1, n + 1).
  • Infinite loop: the condition never becomes False, e.g. forgetting num = num + 17 or X = X - 1 in a while loop.
  • Wrong initial value: product/factorial must start at 1; sum must start at 0; initialise before the loop, not inside it (resetting each time).
  • Indentation: a statement indented into the loop runs every time; one not indented runs once after the loop.
  • range() parameters must be integers: range(0, 4.5) → TypeError; use int().
  • Using a negative step with start < end (e.g. range(1, 5, -1)) gives no iterations.
cards.zh:
• 差一错误 (off-by-one)：要包括 n 就写 range(1, n + 1)。
  • 无限循环：while 内忘记更新变量。
  • 初值错误：乘积从 1、总和从 0，且在循环前初始化。
  • 缩排：缩排在循环内每次执行，不缩排只在循环后执行一次。
  • range 参数必须整数；负步长但 start < end 则一次都不执行。

ex.a: X never changes, so it is an infinite loop. Add X = X - 1 inside the loop body.
ex.az: 循环体内要更新 X。

cards.t: Chapter exercise skills: VIP points, odd sums, lucky draw
cards.en:
VIP points (1 point for spending 50, +1 for every additional 10): 
total = float(input())
points = 0
if total >= 50:
    total = total - 40
    points = total // 10
(After subtracting 40, total // 10 gives 1 point for the first 50 plus 1 per extra 10; the while loop in the book does the same by repeated subtraction.)
Sum of first X odd numbers: change sum = sum + 2 * i to sum = sum + 2 * i - 1.
Lucky draw with A = random.randint(1, 100): 
if A <= 5: print("Gaming console")
elif A <= 30: print("Toy car")
elif A <= 60: print("Candy")
else: print("Better luck next time")
Derivative of a monomial (coef·xn → coef·n·xn−1): coef = coef * exponent then exponent = exponent - 1; order matters.
cards.zh: VIP 积分：减 40 后 total // 10。首 X 个奇数之和：改成 2 * i - 1。抽奖：randint(1,100) 配 if…elif 由小到大判断上限。单项式导数：先 coef = coef * exponent，再 exponent − 1，次序不能倒。

cards.tz: 一维数组与 Python 列表
cards.en:
A one-dimensional array (1D array) stores a series of data of the same data type (e.g. integers or strings) sequentially. Arrays let a program store large amounts of data and process them with loops, which is the basis of many algorithms (sum, search, count, max/min, sort).

Python has no built-in array type. Instead we use a list: an ordered sequence of items. A Python list may mix data types, but in this chapter (and in DSE answers that model arrays) every list stores items of one data type only, so that it behaves like an array.

Key points: each item is reached by its index; a list has a length (number of items); items are kept in order.
cards.zh:
一维数组 (1D array) 按顺序存放一串相同数据类型的数据（如整数或字符串），可以存大量数据，并配合循环实现求和、搜索、计数、找最大最小值等算法。

Python 没有数组，而是用 list（列表）：an ordered sequence of items（有序的项目序列）。Python 列表其实可以混合不同类型，但本章为了模拟数组，同一个列表只存同一种数据类型。

要点：用索引 (index) 访问每一项；列表有长度；项目保持顺序。

ex.q: Which is better for storing the heights of 40 students: 40 separate variables or one list? Explain.
ex.a:
One list, e.g. height = [0.0]*40. All items have the same type (float) and can be processed with one loop, e.g. 
for i in range(0, 40):
    total = total + height[i]
40 separate variables would need 40 separate statements.
ex.az: 用一个列表。数据类型相同，可以用一个 for 循环处理全部数据；40 个变量则要写 40 句。

cards.en:
In Python you do not declare a variable's data type; the type is tagged during assignment. So a list is created simply by assigning values in square brackets:
list1 = ["David", "Lily", "Ben"]
list2 = [34, 23, 90, 56, 100]
list1 holds 3 strings (indices 0 to 2); list2 holds 5 integers (indices 0 to 4). print(type(list1)) outputs <class 'list'>.
An empty list is [].
cards.zh:
Python 不需要声明变量类型，类型在赋值时自动标记 (tagged)。所以直接用方括号赋值就能建立列表，例如 list1 = ["David", "Lily", "Ben"]（3 个字符串，索引 0–2）和 list2 = [34, 23, 90, 56, 100]（5 个整数，索引 0–4）。
print(type(list1)) 会输出 <class 'list'>。空列表写作 []。

ex.q: Create a list days holding the strings Mon to Fri and state the index of "Wed".
ex.a:
days = ["Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"]
"Wed" is the 3rd item, so its index is 2.
ex.az: 第 3 项的索引是 2，因为索引从 0 开始。

cards.en:
Whether you assign list items one by one or with a for loop, the list must already exist with default values before items can be accessed. This process is called initialisation.
list3 = [0]*10   # 10 items, all 0
list4 = [""]*5   # 5 items, all empty string
[x]*n makes a list of n copies of x. Use 0 (or 0.0) for numbers and "" for strings.
Enrichment: Python lists are dynamic (length can change), so you can also start from [] and add items with list1 = list1 + ["David"] or list2.append("Ken").
cards.zh:
在用索引逐项赋值或用 for 循环赋值之前，列表必须先建立并赋予预设值，这个过程叫 initialisation（初始化）。
[0]*10 建立 10 个 0；[""]*5 建立 5 个空字符串。
延伸：Python 列表是动态 (dynamic) 的，长度可变，也可以从 [] 开始，用 list1 = list1 + ["David"] 或 list2.append("Ken") 逐项加入。

ex.q:
What is printed?
a = [0]*3
a = a + [7]
a.append(9)
print(a, len(a))
ex.a: [0]*3 gives [0, 0, 0]; adding [7] gives [0, 0, 0, 7]; append 9 gives [0, 0, 0, 7, 9]. Output: [0, 0, 0, 7, 9] 5
ex.az: 先得 [0,0,0]，接上 [7]，再 append 9，长度 5。

cards.en:
In pseudocode (in this book's DSE convention) array indices often start from 1, but in Python, list indices start from 0. For list1 = ["David","Lily","Ben"], list1[0] is "David". For list2 = [34,23,90,56,100], list2[2] is 90.
The last index of a list with length N is N-1.
Why 0? (Enrichment) An array occupies consecutive memory cells. The program stores only the base address of the first item in a pointer variable. The address of item i is base address + i, so the index is the distance from the first item; the first item's distance is 0. E.g. if arr = 3046, arr[3] is at 3046 + 3 = 3049.
cards.zh:
伪代码中数组索引常由 1 开始，但 Python 列表索引由 0 开始。长度为 N 的列表，最后一个索引是 N-1。
为何由 0 开始？数组存放在连续的内存位置，程序只用指针 (pointer) 记住第一项的起始地址 (base address)。第 i 项地址 = 起始地址 + i，所以索引就是与第一项的距离，第一项距离为 0。例如 arr = 3046，则 arr[3] 在 3046+3 = 3049。

ex.q: A list has 12 items. State the first and last valid index. An array's base address is 2000; where is item index 5?
ex.a: First index 0, last index 12-1 = 11. Address = 2000 + 5 = 2005.

cards.en:
Only after a list is created can we use list name + index to access a specified item. Assignment statements update items:
list2 = [34, 23, 90, 56, 100]
list2[0] = 28            # put 28 into list2[0]
list2[1] = list2[2] - 5  # read list2[2], subtract 5, store in list2[1]
for i in range(0, 5):    # assign consecutively with a loop
    list2[i] = i         # list2 becomes [0, 1, 2, 3, 4]
range(0, 5) gives the sequence 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 (the end value 5 is excluded).
cards.zh:
列表建立后，才可用列表名 + 索引读写某一项。
list2[0] = 28 把 28 放入 list2[0]；list2[1] = list2[2] - 5 读 list2[2] 减 5 后存入 list2[1]；用 for 循环可逐项赋值。
range(0, 5) 产生 0,1,2,3,4，不包括 5。

ex.az: 注意 a[2] 用的是已更新的 a[0]=10。

cards.t: Misconception: accessing items not in the list
cards.tz: 误解：访问不存在的项目
cards.en:
Items that are not in the list cannot be accessed. Two typical errors:
list1 = []
list1[0] = "David"   # error: the list created has no items (empty list)

list2 = [0]*5
list2[5] = 5         # error: no index 5 (out of range)
Both raise IndexError: list assignment index out of range. Fix: initialise with enough items ([0]*6), or add items with + [x] / append().
cards.zh:
不能访问列表中不存在的项目。常见错误：
① 对空列表 [] 直接赋值 list1[0] = ...（empty list 空列表）；
② [0]*5 只有索引 0–4，却写 list2[5]（out of range 超出范围）。
两者都会出现 IndexError。修正：初始化足够长度（如 [0]*6），或用 + [x]/append() 加项。

ex.q:
State why each program fails:
height = []
height[0] = 175
age = [34, 23, 81, 56, 8]
for i in range(1, 6):
    print(age[i])
ex.a: (1) height is an empty list; index 0 does not exist. (2) range(1, 6) gives 1–5; age[5] is out of range (last index is 4), and age[0] is never printed.
ex.az: ① 空列表；② 访问 age[5] 超出范围，且漏了 age[0]。

cards.en:
Outputting specified items: print(list1[1]) prints one item.
Outputting the whole list with a loop:
list2 = [34, 23, 90, 56, 100]
for i in range(0, 5):
    print(list2[i])   # one item per line
Enrichment, two more ways: print(list2) prints [34, 23, 90, 56, 100] (with brackets); for item in list1: print(item) loops over the items directly without an index.
To print in reverse order, use range(N-1, -1, -1) (step -1, stop before -1).
cards.zh:
输出指定项目：print(list1[1])。
用循环输出整个列表：for i in range(0, 5): print(list2[i])，每项一行。
延伸：print(list2) 会连方括号一起输出；for item in list1: 可直接逐项取值，不需索引。
倒序输出用 range(N-1, -1, -1)（步长 -1，停在 -1 之前）。

ex.q: Print sec = [1.1, 0.98, 0.99] in reverse order.
ex.a:
for i in range(2, -1, -1):
    print(sec[i])
Output: 0.99, 0.98, 1.1 (one per line). Note range(3, -1, -1) would start at sec[3] and cause an IndexError.
ex.az: 由索引 2 开始倒数到 0；若由 3 开始会超出范围。

cards.en:
Sometimes we do not wish to change the original list, so we create another list to save the copy. Initialise a new list of the same length, then use a for loop to copy the items one by one:
list2 = [34, 23, 90, 56, 100]
new_list = [0]*5
for i in range(0, 5):
    new_list[i] = list2[i]
Changing new_list afterwards does not change list2. (Note: new_list = list2 does not copy; both names would refer to the same list.)
Variation: new_list[i] = list2[N-1-i] copies in reverse.
cards.zh:
不想改动原列表时，就另建一个列表保存副本：先初始化同长度的新列表，再用 for 循环逐项复制。之后修改 new_list 不会影响 list2。
注意：new_list = list2 并不是复制，两个名字指向同一个列表。
变化：new_list[i] = list2[N-1-i] 可倒序复制。

ex.q:
Dry run:
original_list = [10, 12, 19, 25]
new_list = [0]*4
for i in range(0, 4):
    new_list[i] = original_list[3-i]
    print(new_list[i])
ex.a: i=0: original_list[3]=25; i=1: 19; i=2: 12; i=3: 10. Output: 25, 19, 12, 10 (one per line).
ex.az: 逐项由尾到头复制，输出 25、19、12、10。

cards.en:
Many list bugs come from wrong loop ranges:
  • Out of range: num[i+1] inside for i in range(0, 7) on a 7-item list reads num[7] when i = 6.
  • Off-by-one start: range(1, N) skips item 0.
  • Reverse loop starting at N: range(3, -1, -1) on a 3-item list reads index 3.
When an expression uses i+1, loop only to N-2 (range(0, N-1)); when it uses i-1, start from 1.
cards.zh:
很多列表错误来自循环范围：
  • 用了 num[i+1]，i 到最后一项时会超出范围；
  • range(1, N) 会漏掉第 0 项；
  • 倒序由 N 开始会超出范围。
用 i+1 时循环只到 N-2，即 range(0, N-1)；用 i-1 时由 1 开始。

ex.q:
Dry run:
even = [2, 4, 6, 8, 10]
for i in range(0, 4):
    even[i] = even[i] + even[i+1]
    print(even[i])
ex.a: i=0: 2+4=6; i=1: 4+6=10; i=2: 6+8=14; i=3: 8+10=18. Output 6, 10, 14, 18. No error because i+1 reaches at most 4.
ex.az: i 最大 3，i+1 最大 4，未超出范围。

ex.q:
Dry run:
odd = [1, 3, 5, 7, 9]
for i in range(1, 5):
    odd[i] = odd[i] + odd[i-1]
    print(odd[i])
ex.a: Uses updated values: odd[1]=3+1=4; odd[2]=5+4=9; odd[3]=7+9=16; odd[4]=9+16=25. Output 4, 9, 16, 25 (running total).
ex.az: odd[i-1] 已被更新，所以是累计和。

cards.t: Finding the sum of a list
cards.en:
To find the sum, set an accumulator total = 0, then use a loop to add the list items one by one:
time = [15.1, 14.9, 15.6, 16.1, 16.8, 17.0, 16.9, 16.5]
total = 0
for i in range(0, 8):
    total = total + time[i]
print(total)   # 128.9
Pseudocode: total ← 0; for i from 0 to N-1: total ← total + time[i]. The accumulator must be initialised to 0 before the loop, not inside it.
(Enrichment: built-in sum(the_list) gives the same result.)
cards.zh:
求总和：先设累加器 total = 0，再用循环逐项加上列表项目。累加器必须在循环之前设为 0，放在循环内会每次被清零。
延伸：内置函数 sum(the_list) 效果相同。

ex.q: Find the total of mark = [80, 90, 75, 60] with a loop.
ex.a:
mark = [80, 90, 75, 60]
total = 0
for i in range(0, 4):
    total = total + mark[i]
print(total)   # 305

cards.en:
Average = sum ÷ number of items. After the summing loop: avg = total/8 → 128.9/8 = 16.1125.
Hard-coding 8 means the program must be rewritten for every list length. Better: let N be the length of the list using len(), which returns the total number of items in a list:
N = len(time)
total = 0
for i in range(0, N):
    total = total + time[i]
avg = total/N
Now the same program works for 400 m, 1500 m or 2000 m records (lists of any length). len([1,2,3,4,5,6]) is 6.
cards.zh: 平均值 = 总和 ÷ 项目数。如果把 8 写死，换了长度不同的列表就要改程序。较好的做法是用 len() 取得列表长度 N（returns the total number of items），循环用 range(0, N)，平均值 total/N。这样 400 米、1500 米等不同长度的记录都能用同一程序。

ex.q: time = [14.9, 15.5, 16.1, 15.8]. Give the total and average.

cards.t: Inputting a list with a sentinel (-1)
cards.tz: 用 -1 结束输入建立列表
cards.en:
When the number of items is unknown, read values in a while loop and stop when the user enters a sentinel value such as -1. Start from an empty list and append each record:
time = []
record = float(input("Input a record (input -1 to exit):"))
while record != -1:
    time = time + [record]
    record = float(input("Input a record (input -1 to exit):"))
print("Your record:", time)
Note the input before the loop and the input again at the end of the loop body, so -1 is never added to the list. Afterwards use len(time) for N.
cards.zh:
项目数量未知时，用 while 循环读入，输入结束标记 (sentinel) 如 -1 时停止。由空列表开始，每次 time = time + [record] 加入。
注意：循环前先输入一次，循环体最后再输入，这样 -1 不会被加进列表。之后用 len(time) 取得 N。

ex.q: Fill in: while ______: time = ______ (Textbook Example 5.1).
ex.a: while record != -1: and time = time + [record]. Part (b): N = len(time), for i in range(0, N), avg = total/N.
ex.az: 条件 record != -1；加入用 time + [record]。

cards.zh:
有了平均值 avg 后：
平均偏差 (mean deviation) = 各数与平均值之差的绝对值的平均。没有 abs() 时，用 if/else：大于 avg 加 mark[i]-avg，否则加 avg-mark[i]，最后除以 n。
标准差 (standard deviation) = √(Σ(x−mean)²/n)，需 import math 再用 math.sqrt()。

ex.q: mark = [80, 90, 75, 60]. Find avg, mean deviation and SD.

cards.t: Linear search: is the item present?
cards.tz: 线性搜索：数据是否存在
cards.en:
Linear search checks the list items one by one. A Boolean flag found starts as False and becomes True when the target equals an item; the answer is output at the end:
target = int(input())
found = False
N = len(the_list)
for i in range(0, N):
    if target == the_list[i]:
        found = True
print(found)
Why Boolean? The answer is only yes/no. Pseudocode may write true/TRUE/True, but Python only accepts True/False.
To search strings, remove int() so the input stays a string. IDs such as "002" are stored as strings so leading zeros are kept.
cards.zh:
线性搜索 (linear search)：逐项检查。用布尔旗标 (flag) found，初值 False，遇到相同项设为 True，最后输出。
为何用布尔？答案只有“是/否”。伪代码大小写不限，但 Python 只接受 True/False。
搜索字符串时不要用 int()。像 "002" 这类编号要存为字符串，否则前导 0 会消失。

ex.q: Scholarship list ["002", "134", "192"]; input 192 → "Congratulation!", else "Sorry, you are not on the list."
ex.a:
scholarship = ["002", "134", "192"]
application_num = input("Please input your number: ")
found = False
for i in range(0, 3):
    if application_num == scholarship[i]:
        found = True
if found == True:
    print("Congratulation!")
else:
    print("Sorry, you are not on the list.")
ex.az: 逐项比较，找到就设 found=True，最后判断输出。

cards.t: Search with while: stop at the first match
cards.tz: 用 while 搜索：找到即停
cards.en:
A for loop always checks every item. To find the first list index that stores the target and stop early, use a while loop with two conditions:
index = -1
found = False
i = 0
N = len(the_list)
while i < N and found == False:
    if target == the_list[i]:
        found = True
        index = i
    i = i + 1
print(index)
index = -1 means not found (-1 is never a valid index). Alternatively loop while i < N and index == -1 and drop the flag. Position (rank) = index + 1.
cards.zh:
for 循环一定检查所有项目。要找第一个存放目标的索引并提早停止，用 while 循环加两个条件：i < N and found == False。
index = -1 代表未找到（-1 不是有效索引）。也可用 while i < N and index == -1 省去旗标。名次 = index + 1。

ex.q: rank = ["6012","0122","1122","7201","5402"]. Input 0122 → "Congratulation! Your rank is 2".
ex.a:
index = -1
i = 0
while i < 5 and index == -1:
    if runner_num == rank[i]:
        index = i
    i = i + 1
if index != -1:
    print("Congratulation! Your rank is", index+1)
else:
    print("Work hard next year.")
ex.az: 找到 index=1，输出名次 index+1=2。

cards.en:
Two lists whose items correspond by position are parallel lists: e.g. runner_name[i] is the name of the runner whose number is rank[i]; contact_no[i] is the phone number of contact_name[i]. Search one list to get an index, then use the same index on the other list:
if index != -1:
    print("Congratulation", runner_name[index], end="")
    print("! Your rank is", index+1)
end="" stops print() from going to a new line.
cards.zh: 两个列表按位置一一对应，叫平行列表：例如 runner_name[i] 是号码 rank[i] 的跑手名字。先在一个列表搜索得到索引，再用同一索引读另一个列表。end="" 令 print 不换行。

ex.q: Contact search: input "Yvonne" → "The phone no of Yvonne is 2715 5432" (Textbook Checkpoint 5.3).
ex.a:
contact_name = ["Mary","Peter","Smith","Yvonne","Yee"]
contact_no = ["9319 1919","9836 1234","6456 3210","2715 5432","5432 9876"]
search_name = input("Search contact: ")
pos = -1
i = 0
while i < 5 and pos == -1:
    if search_name == contact_name[i]:
        pos = i
    i = i + 1
if pos != -1:
    print("The phone no of", search_name, "is", contact_no[pos])
else:
    print("Not found in the contact list.")
ex.az: 用 pos 记下位置，再读 contact_no[pos]。

cards.t: Searching for a pair of consecutive items
cards.en:
To check whether item A is immediately followed by item B, compare the_list[i] and the_list[i+1]. The loop must stop at N-2 so that i+1 stays in range:
pair = False
for i in range(0, 4):          # 5 items: i = 0..3
    if rank[i] == search_num1 and rank[i+1] == search_num2:
        pair = True
The same idea is used for checking order (compare neighbours) and longest streaks.
cards.zh: 要检查 A 之后是否紧接 B，比较 the_list[i] 和 the_list[i+1]，循环只到 N-2，避免 i+1 超出范围。同样的想法用于检查排序和计算最长连胜。

ex.a: At i = 3: rank[3] = "7201" and rank[4] = "5402" → pair = True → "This pair is found!"
ex.az: i=3 时成立。

cards.t: Counting data that meet a condition
cards.en:
Counting uses a counter count = 0 and adds 1 whenever an item meets a given condition:
bound = int(input())
count = 0
N = len(the_list)
for k in range(0, N):
    if the_list[k] > bound:
        count = count + 1
print(count)
Change the condition to count items lower than (<), higher than (>) or equal to (==) a number. Comparing with </> works for integers and floats; == also works for counting identical strings.
Difference from sum: sum adds the item value, count adds 1.
cards.zh:
计数：设计数器 count = 0，每遇到符合条件的项目就加 1。把条件改为 <、> 或 == 即可计算小于、大于或等于某数的项目数。</> 适用于整数和浮点数，== 也可用来数相同的字符串。
与求和的分别：求和加的是项目值，计数加的是 1。

ex.q: mark = [87, 45, 79, 100, 50, 35, 90, 100, 60, 80]. (a) How many got 100? (b) How many failed (below 50)? (c) Print class numbers of those who failed (Textbook Example 5.4).
ex.a:
found = 0
for i in range(0, 10):
    if mark[i] == 100:
        found = found + 1      # 2
fail = 0
for i in range(0, 10):
    if mark[i] < 50:
        fail = fail + 1        # 2 (45, 35)
for i in range(0, 10):
    if mark[i] < 50:
        print(i+1)             # 2 and 6

cards.zh: 计数可以配合重设：current 记录当前连胜，遇 L 重设为 0；longest 记录最高值。这个例子输出 4。

ex.q: What is the longest streak of ["W","W","L","W","W","W"]?
ex.a: current: 1,2,0,1,2,3 → longest = 3.

cards.t: Finding the largest or smallest value
cards.zh:
用一个暂存变量，逐项比较，保留较大（或较小）的值。
为何由索引 1 开始？因为 largest 已设为 the_list[0]，不用跟自己比较。初值要设为第一项而不是 0，否则全是负数时会出错。找最小值用 <。一个循环可以同时找最大和最小值，比两个循环少重复一次。
延伸：max()、min()。

ex.q: Find who got the lowest mark in mark = [87, 85, 79, 100, 50, 35, 90, 100, 60, 80] (class no. = index+1).
ex.a:
lowest_mark = mark[0]
lowest_no = 0
for i in range(1, 10):
    if mark[i] < lowest_mark:
        lowest_mark = mark[i]
        lowest_no = i
print("The lowest mark is student no.", lowest_no+1)   # 6
ex.az: 记下最小值的同时记下索引，输出索引+1 = 6。

ex.q: Print all students with the highest mark (ties).
ex.az: 先找最高分，再用第二个循环列出所有等于最高分的学号。

cards.t: Checking whether a list is in order
cards.zh:
逐项与下一项比较，若有一对次序错误便把旗标设为 False。上例检查升序；循环到 N-2，因为用到 k+1。检查降序则用 the_list[k+1] > the_list[k]。
旗标 (flag) 是监察程序状态的变量；结果只有是/否，应用布尔类型。
要同时判断升序和降序：设两个旗标都为 True，遇到违反的一对就设为 False。

ex.q: Write code to output "ascending sorted", "descending sorted" or "unsorted".
ex.a:
as_sorted_list = True
de_sorted_list = True
for k in range(0, len(winning_num)-1):
    if winning_num[k] > winning_num[k+1]:
        as_sorted_list = False
    if winning_num[k] < winning_num[k+1]:
        de_sorted_list = False
if de_sorted_list:
    print("The list is descending sorted.")
elif as_sorted_list:
    print("The list is ascending sorted.")
else:
    print("The list is unsorted.")

cards.t: Deleting an item from a list
cards.en:
To delete the item at index P, shift every later item one place forward, then the list is one item shorter:
N = len(the_list)
for k in range(P, N-1):
    the_list[k] = the_list[k+1]
N = N - 1
Pseudocode: for k from P to N-2: the_list[k] ← the_list[k+1]; N ← N-1. The last position still holds an old value; the book resets it, e.g. eca_code[4] = "" or wait[9] = 0.
Enrichment: the_list.pop(P) deletes the item at index P directly.
cards.zh:
删除索引 P 的项目：把 P 之后每一项向前移一位（the_list[k] = the_list[k+1]，k 由 P 到 N-2），然后 N 减 1。最后一格仍是旧值，书中会重设，例如设为 "" 或 0。
延伸：the_list.pop(P) 可直接删除。

ex.q: Delete "Paul" (index 1) from ["Tony","Paul","Kelly","Wendy","Jack"] (Textbook Example 5.7).
ex.a:
for k in range(1, 4):
    eca_code[k] = eca_code[k+1]
eca_code[4] = ""
Result: ["Tony","Kelly","Wendy","Jack",""].
ex.az: 由索引 1 起逐项前移，最后一项清空。

cards.t: Adding (inserting) an item into a list
cards.en:
To insert new_data at index P: first extend the list by one, then shift items from the end backward one place, working from the last index down to P+1, and finally store the new item:
the_list = the_list + [0]
N = len(the_list)
for k in range(N-1, P, -1):
    the_list[k] = the_list[k-1]
the_list[P] = new_data
Why backwards? Shifting forwards from P would overwrite items before they are moved. Enrichment: the_list.insert(P, new_data).
cards.zh:
在索引 P 插入 new_data：先把列表加长一格，再由最后一个索引倒数到 P+1，把每项向后移一位，最后把新项目放在 P。
为何要倒着移？若由 P 开始向后移，会在搬动前把项目覆盖掉。延伸：the_list.insert(P, new_data)。

ex.q: Insert 9001 at index 4 of a 10-item list wait (Textbook Checkpoint 5.7).
ex.a:
wait = wait + [0]
for k in range(10, 4, -1):
    wait[k] = wait[k-1]
wait[4] = 9001
ex.az: 加长后长度 11，k 由 10 倒数到 5，然后 wait[4] = 9001。

cards.t: Moving an item to the front
cards.en:
To move the item at index P to the first position: save it in temp, shift the items before P backward one place (from P down to 1), then put temp in index 0:
temp = the_list[P]
for k in range(P, 0, -1):
    the_list[k] = the_list[k-1]
the_list[0] = temp
The list length does not change.
cards.zh: 把索引 P 的项目移到最前：先存入 temp，再把 P 之前的项目向后移一位（k 由 P 倒数到 1），最后把 temp 放到索引 0。列表长度不变。

ex.q: show = ["2A","3B","1C","4E","5A"]; move "4E" (index 3) to the beginning (Textbook Example 5.8).
ex.a:
temp = show[3]
for k in range(3, 0, -1):
    show[k] = show[k-1]
show[0] = temp
Result: ["4E","2A","3B","1C","5A"].
ex.az: temp 先保存 4E，其他向后移。

cards.en:
Python provides built-ins for common list algorithms (useful to check your own loop versions):
CodeResult for [12, 8, -6, 40, 23]
sum(the_list)77
the_list.index(40) (first index of target)3
max(the_list)40
min(the_list)-6
the_list.insert(2, 1234)[12, 8, 1234, -6, 40, 23]
the_list.pop(2)[12, 8, 40, 23]
In exam questions that ask you to write the algorithm, show the loop version unless built-ins are allowed.
cards.zh:
Python 内置函数可直接完成常见算法：sum() 总和、.index(x) 第一个目标的索引、max()/min()、.insert(P, x) 插入、.pop(P) 删除。
考试若要求写出算法，应写循环版本。

ex.q: For a = [5, 3, 9], what do a.index(9) and, after a.insert(0, 1), a give?
ex.a: a.index(9) = 2. After insert: [1, 5, 3, 9].
ex.az: index 返回 2；插入后为 [1,5,3,9]。

cards.en:
A string is formed by a series of characters. Like a list, each character has an index starting from 0: in word = "Work Hard!", word[0] is 'W', word[4] is a space and the length is 10.
Similarities with lists: read characters by index, loop over them, concatenate with + ("Work Hard" + "er" → "Work Harder").
Difference: strings are immutable: values cannot be assigned to items in a string. word[5] = "h" raises TypeError: 'str' object does not support item assignment. Build a new string instead.
cards.zh:
字符串 (string) 由一串字符 (characters) 组成，和列表一样可用索引（由 0 开始）读取每个字符："Work Hard!" 中 word[0] 是 'W'，word[4] 是空格，长度 10。
相似：可用索引读、可循环、可用 + 连接。
不同：不能直接对字符串的某一项赋值，word[5] = "h" 会出现 TypeError: 'str' object does not support item assignment。要改就要建立新字符串。

ex.q:
What is printed?
otherword = ""
otherword = otherword + "Play"
otherword = otherword + " "
otherword = otherword + "Hard"
print(otherword)
ex.a: Starting from the empty string and concatenating: Play Hard.
ex.az: 由空字符串开始连接，得 Play Hard。

cards.t: Finding the length of a string
cards.en:
len() also returns the length of a string (number of characters, including spaces and punctuation): len("Work Hard") = 9, len("Play Harder") = 11.
Alternatively, count with a for loop over the characters:
word = "Work Hard!"
count = 0
for item in word:
    count = count + 1
print(count)   # 10
Applications: word processors count characters/words; password checkers require 8-20 characters.
cards.zh:
len() 也可求字符串长度（字符数，空格和标点都计算）：len("Work Hard") = 9。
也可以用 for 循环逐个字符计数。
应用：文字处理软件统计字数；密码规则要求 8–20 个字符。

ex.q: Give len("I love coding.").
ex.a: I(1)+space(1)+love(4)+space(1)+coding.(7) = 14.
ex.az: 空格和句号都算，共 14。

cards.t: Finding a character with a for loop
cards.tz: 用 for 循环查找字符
cards.en:
Linear search works on strings too: check the characters one by one; output True if the target character is in the string:
the_string = "Work Hard!"
target = "a"
found = False
N = len(the_string)
for i in range(0, N):
    if target == the_string[i]:
        found = True
print(found)   # True
The for loop is also used to count characters, e.g. vowels: if word[i]=="a" or word[i]=="e" or ...: count = count + 1. A backslash \ can continue a long statement on the next line.
cards.zh:
线性搜索也适用于字符串：逐个字符比较，找到就把 found 设为 True。
for 循环也可用来计数，例如数元音：if word[i]=="a" or word[i]=="e" or ...。反斜线 \ 可把长语句分成多行。

ex.q: Count vowels in "intelligence" (Textbook Example 5.9).
ex.a:
Vowels: i, e, i, e, e → 5. Code: 
count = 0
for i in range(0, len(word)):
    if word[i] == "a" or word[i] == "e" or word[i] == "i" or \
       word[i] == "o" or word[i] == "u":
        count = count + 1
Capital vowels are not counted unless you also test "A","E",... (or use word[i].lower()).
ex.az: 共 5 个；大写元音不会计入，除非同时比较大写字母。

cards.en:
If there are no consecutive spaces, number of words = number of spaces + 1:
sentence = input()
word_count = 0
length = len(sentence)
for i in range(0, length):
    if sentence[i] == " ":
        word_count = word_count + 1
print(word_count + 1)
"This is an example." has 3 spaces → 4 words.
cards.zh: 假设没有连续空格，字数 = 空格数 + 1。"This is an example." 有 3 个空格，所以 4 个字。

ex.q: How many words in "I go to school by bus."?
ex.a: 5 spaces → 6 words.
ex.az: 5 个空格，6 个字。

cards.en:
A word is symmetrical (reads the same backwards, e.g. level, noon, mum) if character i equals character length-1-i for every i:
word = input()
sym = True
length = len(word)
for i in range(0, length):
    if word[i] != word[length-1-i]:
        sym = False
print(sym)
"moon" → False because word[0]='m' ≠ word[3]='n'. Checking only up to length//2 is enough but the full loop is still correct.
cards.zh: 对称字（如 level、noon、mum）：每个 i 都要符合 word[i] == word[length-1-i]。用旗标 sym，发现不等就设为 False。"moon" 的首尾 m 和 n 不同，所以 False。

ex.q: Trace "noon".
ex.a: length 4: compare (0,3) n=n, (1,2) o=o, (2,1), (3,0) all equal → True.
ex.az: 全部相同，输出 True。

cards.t: Finding a character with a while loop
cards.tz: 用 while 循环查找字符
cards.en:
To find the first index that stores the target character and stop there, use a while loop:
the_string = "Work Hard!"
target = "r"
index = -1
found = False
i = 0
N = len(the_string)
while i < N and found == False:
    if target == the_string[i]:
        index = i
        found = True
    i = i + 1
print(index)   # 2
To find the second occurrence, start a second search from first + 1.
cards.zh: 要找目标字符的第一个索引并停止，用 while 循环（条件 i < N and found == False）。"Work Hard!" 中第一个 r 在索引 2。要找第二个，就由第一个位置+1 再搜索一次。

ex.q: Find the length of the second word of a sentence (Textbook Example 5.10).
ex.az: 先找第一个、第二个空格；按 3→2→1 的情况判断，因为较特殊的情况要先检查。

cards.en:
A substring is created when part of the characters in a string are extracted. With the start index and end index, build a new string by adding characters one by one:
word = "Work Hard!"
sub_word = ""
for i in range(0, 4):
    sub_word = sub_word + word[i]
print(sub_word)   # Work
Enrichment: slicing word[start:end] extracts from start up to but not including end: word[5:7] = "Ha", word[2:4] = "rk", word[5:9] = "Hard".
cards.zh:
子字符串 (substring)：从字符串中提取部分字符。知道起始索引和结束索引后，由空字符串开始逐个字符相加。
延伸：切片 word[start:end]，不包括 end：word[5:7] 是 "Ha"，word[5:9] 是 "Hard"。

ex.q:
Dry run (Textbook Activity 5.3):
d = "google.com.hk"
sd = ""
for i in range(7, 10):
    sd = sd + d[i]
print(sd)
ex.a: Indices 7, 8, 9 are 'c','o','m' → com. (For d = "2021.01.01", range(0,4) gives 2021.)
ex.az: 索引 7–9 是 c、o、m。

cards.zh:
结合搜索分隔符与提取子字符串：找空格位置 space，前面是名，后面是姓。for 循环会记下最后一个空格，所以 "Tai Man Chan" 名为 "Tai Man"、姓 "Chan"。
找顶级域名 (TLD) 同理：找最后一个点，取后面的字符，www.gov.hk → hk。这里用 for 而非 while，是因为要找最后一个而不是第一个。

ex.q: Write code to print the TLD of a domain name (Textbook Checkpoint 5.9).
ex.a:
domain = input()
tld = ""
N = len(domain)
dot = -1
for i in range(0, N):
    if domain[i] == ".":
        dot = i
if dot != -1:
    for i in range(dot+1, N):
        tld = tld + domain[i]
    print(tld)
else:
    print("Not a proper domain name")
ex.az: 找最后一个点，取其后的字符。

cards.en:
ASCII (American Standard Code for Information Interchange) is a common character encoding for English characters. ord() returns the ASCII code of a character: ord("a") = 97, ord("B") = 66.
Comparing strings compares codes: "B" > "a" is False (66 < 97); "s" > "l" is True (115 > 108).
Features of ASCII: capital letters and small letters are each in alphabetical order; digits are in ascending order.
CharactersASCII
'0'–'9'48–57
'A'–'Z'65–90
'a'–'z'97–122
cards.zh:
ASCII 是常用的英文字符编码。ord() 返回字符的 ASCII 码：ord("a")=97，ord("B")=66。
比较字符串时比较的是编码："B" > "a" 为 False。
特点：大写和小写字母各自按字母顺序排列，数字按升序排列。'0'–'9' 是 48–57，'A'–'Z' 是 65–90，'a'–'z' 是 97–122。

ex.q: Evaluate ord("D"), ord("7") and "Z" < "a".

cards.t: Determining the type of a character
cards.zh: ASCII 中字母和数字都按顺序，所以只要检查字符是否在某个范围内：大写 "A"–"Z"，小写 "a"–"z"，数字 "0"–"9"。用 and 连接两个比较。

ex.q: Write the condition for "c is a letter (either case)".
ex.a: (c >= "A" and c <= "Z") or (c >= "a" and c <= "z")
ex.az: 两个范围用 or 连接。

cards.zh:
综合 5.3：检查密码①至少 8 个字符；②没有空格；③至少 1 个数字、1 个大写、1 个小写（用三个旗标和 ASCII 范围）。
确认密码：while password_2 != password: 要求再输入。输入两次的目的：防止打错字，确保用户知道自己设定的密码。
限制：各项检查分开，不合格时不会要求重新输入；可用循环改进，直到全部合格。

ex.q: Is "iAMaPassword" valid under the three rules?
ex.a: 12 characters ✓, no spaces ✓, capital ✓, small ✓, but no digit ✗ → invalid: "At least one digit is required".
ex.az: 缺少数字，所以不合格。

cards.tz: 用两个列表计算加权平均
cards.en:
Integrated programming combines list operations with different control structures. Level 1 example: overall result = Σ(mark×weighting) ÷ Σweighting, using two parallel lists:
mark = [90, 80, 70, 75, 80]
weighting = [1, 1, 2, 2, 4]
final_mark = 0
for i in range(0, 5):
    final_mark = final_mark + mark[i]*weighting[i]
sum_of_weight = 0
for i in range(0, 5):
    sum_of_weight = sum_of_weight + weighting[i]
final_mark = final_mark/sum_of_weight
This year: (90+80+140+150+320)/10 = 78.0. Last year: (75+90+120+170+320)/10 = 77.5.
cards.zh: 综合编程把列表操作和不同控制结构结合。初级例子：加权平均 = Σ(分数×比重) ÷ Σ比重，用两个对应的列表。今年 (90+80+140+150+320)/10 = 78.0。

ex.q: Compute for mark = [60, 80], weighting = [1, 3].

cards.t: Self-ordering kiosk: validate input in a loop
cards.tz: 自助点餐机：在循环中验证输入
cards.zh: 带输入验证的结束标记循环：套餐 n 存在索引 n-1；输入在 1–5 以外就显示 Invalid；输入 -1 结束。1、4、3 号套餐合计 125.8（浮点数可能有微小误差，可用 round）。

ex.q: Why is price[order] wrong?
ex.a: Set 1 is at index 0, so price[order] charges the next set's price and order = 5 gives IndexError. Use price[order-1].
ex.az: 编号与索引相差 1。

cards.t: Department store robot: floors and abs()
cards.tz: 商场机器人：楼层与 abs()
cards.zh: 搜索商店所在楼层（索引即楼层），无效就重新输入；用减法求方向，正数上楼，负数下楼，用 abs() 取绝对值。A→D 上 3 层；G→B 下 5 层。

ex.q: current_floor = 2, goto_floor = 0. Output?
ex.a: direction = -2 → "You should go down 2 level(s)."
ex.az: 方向 -2，下 2 层。

cards.zh: 由位置求相邻差距：space[i] = distance[i+1] - distance[i]，共 N-1 个。再找最小差距或列出差距小于 3 的车（跟车太贴）。space[i] 属于第 i+2 辆车。若从前车车尾量度，用 distance[i+1] - distance_back[i]。

ex.q: With distance = [3,5,8,12,16] and distance_back = [4,7,9,13.5,17], which cars tailgate (<3)?

cards.tz: 第二大 / 第二小的数
cards.zh:
用两个变量。先用头两项设定 maximum 和 secondmax，再由索引 2 开始：比最大还大，就把旧最大移到 secondmax 再更新 maximum；否则若比 secondmax 大，就更新 secondmax。
次序重要：要先搬旧最大值再覆盖。若两者都设为 list[0]，当 list[0] 正是最大值时会出错。[12,8,40,23,6] 第二大 23，第二小 8。

ex.a: Start max=12, second=8. 40 > 12 → second=12, max=40. 23 > 12 → second=23. 6 → no change. Second max = 23.
ex.az: 逐步更新，结果 23。

cards.t: Diving score: drop highest and lowest
cards.tz: 跳水计分：去掉最高最低分
cards.zh: 最后得分 = (总分 − 最高 − 最低) × 难度系数。五位评判例子：(9+8+8.5)×2 = 51。七位评判要去掉最高两个和最低两个：(9.5+10+9)×2 = 57。

ex.q: Scores [6, 7, 8, 9, 10], coef 3.

cards.tz: 开放题：骰子、日期、二进制
cards.en:
Advanced (open-ended) tasks combine lists and strings:
  • Dice frequency: import random; face = [0]*6; each roll r = random.randint(1, 6); face[r-1] = face[r-1] + 1.
  • Date "2021/1/31": find the two "/" positions and extract substrings (or split("/")).
  • Binary to decimal: for each character, value = value*2 + (ord(c) - 48): "110" → 6, "101001" → 41.
cards.zh:
进阶开放题综合列表和字符串：
  • 掷骰频率：用 random.randint(1,6)，计数列表 face[r-1] 加 1。
  • 拆日期：找两个 "/" 的位置再提取子字符串。
  • 二进制转十进制：每个字符 value = value*2 + 该位数值，"110"→6，"101001"→41。

ex.q: Convert "1011" with value = value*2 + bit.
ex.az: 逐位计算得 11。

cards.en:
Voting program: votes = [0]*3; loop until -1; valid input 1–3 → votes[c-1] += 1, else "Invalid"; then find the maximum and count how many candidates share it: if more than one, print "There are candidates with the same votes".
Rock Paper Scissors: computer choice random.randint(1, 3); user wins if (user, comp) is (1,3), (2,1) or (3,2); equal → draw.
Sorting [5, 38, 23, 16, 9] → [5, 9, 16, 23, 38] (e.g. bubble sort: swap neighbours when a[k] > a[k+1], repeat N-1 passes).
Tic-Tac-Toe: board as a 9-item list; check 8 winning lines.
cards.zh:
投票：votes=[0]*3，输入 -1 结束，有效票 votes[c-1] 加 1；找最高票并数有几个候选人同票，多于一个就宣布无效。
包剪揼：电脑用 randint(1,3)；(1,3)、(2,1)、(3,2) 用户赢；相同平手。
排序：冒泡排序，相邻两项次序错就交换，重复 N-1 轮。
井字过三关：用 9 项列表表示棋盘，检查 8 条连线。

ex.q: Votes [3, 2, 5] for Dickson, Emma, Jayden. Result?
ex.a: Max 5, only one candidate has it → "Jayden is the new president of the Student Union".
ex.az: 最高 5 票只有一人，Jayden 当选。

mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch5 Chapter Exercise MC Q5 (p.155)

mc.src: Textbook D2 Ch5 Chapter Exercise MC Q6 (p.155)
